evidence: pass_latches persists a hypothesis, a dependency edge, and retracted evidence through SwarmPlanner and reads each back.
pass_latches dispatches two independent work ids together and keeps a dependent id blocked until its predecessor finishes.
pass_latches counts only the signal named for that workload and ignores another workload's signal and a non-positive amount.
pass_latches retracts evidence and SwarmPlanner dispatch of the dependent work returns INVALID.
pass_latches refuses a plan above the cost bound and refuses a plan while backpressure is set, and the earlier plan stays.
pass_latches keeps the stored procedure body after quorum and runtime are marked lost.
pass_latches calls SwarmDefWork propose for D0-D3, refuses D4, and leaves an unknown level unstored.
pass_latches requires a present human before a D3 action is approved or executed.
pass_latches rejects a negative blast and an execute whose asset or blast differs from the proposal.
pass_latches keeps a single receipt on a repeated execute and leaves an unknown effect ambiguous so a later execute does not retry.
pass_latches rolls back when the canary fails, keeps the asset and receipt, and does not mark rollback when the canary passes.
pass_latches leaves the receipt in place when retaliation is refused as out of scope.
pass_latches accepts only a listed recipient, a matching purpose, and a TLP 2.0 marking, and a refused recipient is not stored.
pass_latches calls SwarmDefense publish and an embargo expiry without both protections stores nothing.
pass_latches publishes only when sanitized and validated are both true.
pass_latches returns the same not-visible result for a missing id and for an id stored on another case.
pass_latches records a higher retraction version and leaves a different artifact body and version unchanged.
pass_latches leaves training consent false after a share and sets it only through the separate training call.
pass_latches accepts STIX 2.0 and 2.1, rejects another version, and keeps the first external-id mapping.
pass_latches enforces collection read and write flags and returns at most the requested page.
pass_latches keeps the original raw event and mapping version when a later raw body differs.
pass_latches checks the rule on every advertised backend and does not add a backend it cannot check.
pass_latches rejects a malformed event and an oversized event and keeps a small well-formed event.
pass_latches imports only the typed subset and does not launch.
